review.finding: The prior A0 evidence was green only on checkouts whose architecture documents already used LF bytes. The registered architecture-bundle test bypassed the controller's canonical hash helper.
review.root_cause: The controller and the test used two different file-digest policies: canonical UTF-8 text hashing in production control versus raw-byte hashing in one acceptance assertion.

considered_options.option: Rewrite architecture files to LF on this workstation
considered_options.reason: That would hide the defect locally and fail again for another Git line-ending policy.

considered_options.option: Change locked architecture hashes to CRLF digests
considered_options.reason: That would violate portable architecture authority and make hashes platform-dependent.

considered_options.option: Make the registered test use the controller's canonical _sha256_file policy
considered_options.reason: It tests the actual portable contract while retaining byte-sensitive hashing for binary artifacts.

review.residual_risk: A1 remains uncompleted and must be reclaimed and revalidated in a later work package. Its current domain edits were already present at A0 claim time and were not modified or claimed by this A0 repair.
